verdict.rationale: CDP documents an official MCP server built into its CLI (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool. It also documents a Coinbase Wallet MCP and an agentic-wallet MCP with per-tool reference pages, such as balance, address and payment-requirement checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably through these MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The CDP CLI includes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool.
Coinbase Wallet MCP connects any AI to your Coinbase Wallet. Check balances, send funds, swap tokens, sign messages, and pay with x402.
your assistant can check balances, send funds, swap tokens, sign messages, execute contract calls, and pay x402-enabled APIs across multiple networks. Every write action requires your approval.
Checks what payment an endpoint requires without actually paying.
